description: Call this tool to pull selected pages into one new PDF, in the order written: "2,4-6" gives four pages. Asking for a page twice copies it twice. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

out_path.description: Name for the extracted PDF; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

pages.description: 1-based pages and ranges to keep, in output order, e.g. "2,4-6" or "5,1,1"

path.description: Name of an uploaded PDF (pdf_upload), or one this server wrote earlier

name: pdf_pages
title: Extract pages into a new PDF
